__comment: Tier 2 plank bench (doc 308; the owner's pick A of two, 2026-11-13): two boards pegged onto two notched plank ends, with a pegged stretcher between them. Its Tier 1 form was the sitting log (the owner's pick of three concepts, 2026-11-11), whose design is kept in the art sources. Exactly two floor cells, 2x1 or 1x2 when rotated.
The seat contact remains one block high.
One usable dwarf seat, with authored seated clearance and side/rear access.
The two-block bench supports one broad dwarf; separate benches can share a table.
description: Two boards pegged onto two plank ends, with a stretcher between them. Sawn and pegged by a Carpenter: one broad seat.
